subject: Account overlap: LumiAnalytics pipeline vs Cedar Cloud integration
messages:
From: Kate Nguyen <kate@lumianalytics.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Quick clarification on account coverage (LumiAnalytics)

Hi Priyom / Sergio,

Hope you’re well — quick one. We noticed outreach from a Redwood contact to one of our customers that we were planning to bring through Cedar Cloud (they're our systems integrator on the project). I’m attaching our current opportunity list so you can see the scope.

Can you confirm whether Redwood plans to engage directly on these accounts or route through Cedar Cloud as the partner lead? We’re trying to avoid duplicate AM touches and make sure incentives and lead routing are clear.

Attached: Lumi_Opportunity_List.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

—Kate
Kate Nguyen
Head of Partnerships | LumiAnalytics
kate@lumianalytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick clarification on account coverage (LumiAnalytics)

Sergio — forwarding Lumi’s note. I pulled our internal touches and attached an initial account map (acct_map_v1.xlsx). Short questions:

- Are these accounts already owned by our Cedar Cloud integration partnership (partner-led)?
- If not, do we want Redwood AE ownership or a co-sell model?

Proposed immediate steps:
1) Confirm partner vs Redwood ownership for the list (I can flag in HubSpot).
2) Agree on co-sell motions and revenue split for the opportunities that require both integration and resale.
3) Share a one-page account bridge (who owns what) with Lumi and Cedar Cloud.

Ben / Marissa — can you review the attached and add any existing partner commitments or SOWs you’re aware of? I’ll schedule follow-up once we align.

Attachment: acct_map_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:25:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick clarification on account coverage (LumiAnalytics)

Thanks for the ping. Quick context from partner ops: Cedar Cloud is the SI on record for the majority of these logos and has existing integration agreements with Lumi for the data pipeline. My read: we should default to a partner-led motion where Cedar Cloud is the commercial lead and Redwood supports via integration enablement and co-sell assistance.

Specific recommendations:
- Partner-led for accounts where Cedar Cloud has an SOW or resale agreement (flagged in acct_map_v1).
- Co-sell for hybrid deals where Lumi owns product and Cedar Cloud handles deployment. Redwood AE can act as technical/commercial advisor to unblock procurement.
- Update HubSpot: add partner tag "CedarCloud_SI" on the affected companies and set lifecycle stage to "Partner Qualified Lead".

I’ll loop in PartnerOps to publish a short account bridge template. For now, Priyom, suggest you own 2 named logos in the list where we have no existing Cedar SOW — call these out in the matrix and propose Redwood AE ownership.

Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-partner-mapping (account map drafts)

—Sergio
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference

From: Kate Nguyen <kate@lumianalytics.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cedar Cloud Procurement <procurement@cedarcloud.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:08:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick clarification on account coverage (LumiAnalytics)

Thanks for the fast responses. Co-sell sounds good where appropriate — our priority is a single commercial touch per account and clean routing so customers aren’t confused.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you share the final account bridge (we’ll include it in our partner portal so Cedar Cloud sees it)?
2) A 30-min alignment call with Priyom, Cedar Cloud AM, and our partnerships lead would be helpful to confirm commercial terms and next steps.

We can be flexible on the cadence — appreciate the help.

—Kate

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Nguyen <kate@lumianalytics.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Account bridge & next steps — LumiAnalytics <> Cedar Cloud

Kate / team — thanks. Attached is the finalized account bridge (acct_bridge_matrix_final.xlsx) which assigns partner vs Redwood ownership and the recommended motion per account. High-level summary:

- 9 accounts: Cedar Cloud partner-led (SOW/resale on file).
- 3 accounts: Co-sell (Lumi product, Cedar deployment) — Redwood AE to support technical pricing & procurement. I will be the Redwood AE on these.
- 2 accounts: Redwood direct (no existing Cedar SOW) — Priyom to lead outreach.

Action items:
- Priyom: update HubSpot tags to reflect partner assignments and add the account bridge to the company record (I’ll do this by EOD).
- Sergio / PartnerOps: publish the bridge to the partner portal and notify Cedar Cloud PMs.
- Kate: confirm preferred rep for Cedar Cloud PMs and we’ll schedule the 30-min alignment.

Attachments: acct_bridge_matrix_final.xlsx
Related links: https://calendly.com/priyom/30min-partner-align

If that looks good I’ll send a short note to Cedar Cloud and schedule the call.

Thanks all — quick turnaround on a messy overlap and we should avoid duplicate touches going forward.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0133
